snippet.title: Galidor: Defenders of the Outer Dimension (GBA) Gameplay
snippet.description:
I'm not sure where, or why I acquired this one, but I decided to share it with you.

This one's based off of a short lived TV show of the same name I do believe. I never watched it, but I remember thinking it looked pretty dumb at the time. 

This game is OK, but it's painfully generic. There are some interesting ideas at play, but if you even so much as played a mediocre platformer during the 16-bit days, you've already seen everything this game has to offer.

The one big thing that even sets this game apart, isn't it's gameplay, or it's terrible, and I mean terrible, floaty and often times unresponsive controls. The only real positive aspect of this one is it's awesome soundtrack.

The gameplay may be pretty standard, and the controls may be pretty unresponsive, but the music is great. If the developer would have spent as much time polishing up the gameplay as they did making a rocking soundtrack, then I may be able to recommend this game to people.

As it stands, this is an only if you find it for extremely cheap, or are a nostalgic fan of the TV show buy.
